title: Plan constraints
description: What a coverage plan for the synthetic expansion area must satisfy (rule G9). Part of the API contract (rule A1). Costs are IDR; distances km; coverage is indoor service (rule G3).

schema_version.description: Contract version the set was written for; any 1.x version is accepted (rule A1: only a major bump breaks).

area.description: Candidate sites and villages inside this box are in play.

objective.description: max_persons and max_villages count covered villages; min_capex minimizes capital cost subject to the other constraints.

technology.description: Which service counts as covered; both needs LTE and GSM.

must_cover.description: Villages that must be covered: those with a school, those with at least min_persons, and the named ones.

capex_budget_idr.description: Build, backhaul and power capital cost of all chosen sites.

monthly_opex_limit_idr.description: Monthly backhaul and power cost of all chosen sites.

power_rule.description: A site takes grid power when the grid line is within grid_within_km, else solar.

backhaul_rule.description: Fiber when the fiber route is within fiber_within_km; microwave only where the hop clears this fraction of the first Fresnel zone; satellite always.

min_persons_share.description: Share of the area's persons that must be covered.
